question: Where is the Raniji ki baori or the 'Queen's Stepwell', the largest among the fifty step wells that were built to meet the need for water located?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Bundi in Rajasthan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raniji ki Baori** (or **Queen's stepwell**) is a noted stepwell located in Bundi town in Rajasthan state in India.
 
• It was construct in 1699 by Rani Nathavati Ji Solanki who was the junior queen of the **ruling Rao Raja Anirudh Singh of ****Bundi.**
 
• It was build during the reign of her son **Maharao Raja Budh** Singh who govern Bundi from 1695 AD to 1729 AD.
 
• Raniji ki Baori has amazing cleft on its pillars and a giant arched gate.
 
• **Stone elephant statues** that face each other stand in the region. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
